title: Glasgow–Blatchford
subtitle: Upper GI bleed intervention risk
summary: The weighted score depends on exact laboratory ranges. It must not be calculated from assumed values or used as a stand-alone prehospital discharge score.
population: Blood urea, haemoglobin adjusted for sex, systolic BP, pulse, melaena, syncope, hepatic disease and cardiac failure.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: The weighted score depends on exact laboratory ranges. It must not be calculated from assumed values or used as a stand-alone prehospital discharge score.
